name: expert-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap a project-local council of generated domain experts. Cross-platform: two meta-agents (prompt-engineer + project-manager) generate a tailored expert roster per project, written to ./.claude/agents/ on Claude Code or ./agents/ on portable hosts (Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode).

x-runtime-compatibility.notes: File generation is portable across listed runtimes. Native subagent dispatch is host-specific; portable mode writes paste-ready agent files but invocation syntax depends on the host.
